يستبعد (form X)

# يُسْتَبْعَدُ (yustabʕadu) /jus.tab.ʕa.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
# يَسْتَبْعِدَ (yastabʕida) /jas.tab.ʕi.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْعَد
